bands.name: Good
bands.advice: Clean air. Nothing to plan around.

bands.name: Satisfactory
bands.advice: Fine for almost everyone. People who are unusually sensitive may notice slight discomfort.

bands.name: Moderate
bands.advice: People with asthma, heart or lung conditions, children and older adults may feel it. Go easier on long outdoor exercise.

bands.name: Poor
bands.advice: Most people may feel some discomfort over long exposure. Sensitive groups should cut down time outdoors.

bands.name: Very Poor
bands.advice: Long exposure can bring on breathing trouble. Skip outdoor exercise and keep windows shut at the worst hours.

bands.name: Severe
bands.advice: Affects healthy people too. Stay indoors where you can; sensitive groups should not go out.

models.label: Persistence
models.about: Tomorrow repeats the newest reading the forecast has.

models.label: Climatology
models.about: The station's average over every earlier day.

models.label: Raw CAMS
models.about: The global forecast as published, uncorrected.

models.label: CAMS rescaled
models.about: CAMS times its recent ratio to the station (last 30 days).
models.verdict: Not clearly better in burning season

models.label: Ridge regression (shipped)
models.about: The shipped model: a penalised linear fit in log space.

models.label: Ridge + smoke terms
models.about: Ridge, letting fires and the westerly count for more in burning season.

models.label: Analog days
models.about: Averages the most similar past days on the same inputs.
models.verdict: Not clearly better in burning season

models.label: Gradient boosting
models.about: Small trees fitted one after another, each on what is left.

models.label: Neural network
models.about: One hidden layer of sixteen units, heavily regularised.

models.label: Ensemble
models.about: The average of ridge, analogs, forest, boosting and network.
